comparison: original lexical packets unchanged versus recovered combined
diversity: Source family = SHA256 of declaration text after replacing every decimal digit run by #. No identifier, query, path, oracle or semantic classification exceptions. Within each mechanism, valid contributions from the same source family share the first-occurrence family rank. Selection uses rounds: one target per family in the first round, second representatives only after all families have had a turn. This is redundancy management, NOT semantic equivalence.
fusion: Sum exact rational 1/(60+one-based distinct-family rank) over contributing mechanisms; no numeric score mixing. Sort confidence (exact symbol equal to entire query, then structural answers, then others), descending RRF, best family rank, target lexical tie-break.
identity: (requested visible source-manifest revision, relative source path, symbol, declaration line); source revision commits source hashes. One payload per target.
input: exact retained III.8 ranked mechanism lists; no new embeddings/extraction/search

mutations.fallback: Use stale A-derived lists for B; fuse/select before validation; then drop any selected merged target containing an invalid contribution without refill, suppressing fresh lexical contributions.
mutations.freshness: Use retained A-derived lists for requested B; bypass derived revision/source/edge checks.
mutations.isolation: Use retained global III.8 isolation lists; skip domain enforcement.

packet: One scoped current revision hash; entries with target/path::symbol, authoritative line, first 80 source characters, discovery codes L/S/G. Structural edges use entry indices. Complete envelope includes diagnostics (selected count, partial), status and derived freshness state. Greedy whole-entry additions tested with complete serialized UTF-8 bytes and final metadata; rejected entries never consume bytes.
post_outcome_tuning: Forbidden; only implementation corrections to execute this declared policy may occur, explicitly retained.
reservation: All valid exact whole-symbol lexical matches precede other candidates; generic equality confidence, never oracle membership.
validation: Per contribution: trusted lineage/domain/policy, current source identity/hash/text/line, derived visible revision and structural AST relations; remove invalid contributions before any fusion/ranking/budget competition. Independently fresh lexical contributions survive.
